related.title: MongoDB：嵌入文件與參照邊界
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以唯一 member 與 score 建排行，確認更新分數不會新增第二筆同 member。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build a leaderboard of unique members and scores and verify updating one member does not duplicate it. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 比較訂單明細嵌入與商品參照，按讀寫模式決定資料邊界。
related.differenceEn: Compare embedded order lines with product references and choose boundaries from access patterns.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Sorted set 的 member 唯一而 score 可相同；同分次序遵循系統定義，需與產品排名政策分開。 教學基準：90+15 = 105 B updated score；第二檢核：4 = 4 unique members。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
嵌入可在單文件中保持相關資料，卻可能造成重複與成長；參照需要額外讀取或 join。 教學基準：20*120+200 = 2600 embedded modeled bytes；第二檢核：20*16+200 = 520 reference-only modeled bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Members are unique while scores may tie; system tie ordering is distinct from product ranking policy. Teaching baseline: 90+15 = 105 B updated score; second check: 4 = 4 unique members. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Embedding colocates related data but may duplicate and grow; references need extra reads or joins. Teaching baseline: 20*120+200 = 2600 embedded modeled bytes; second check: 20*16+200 = 520 reference-only modeled bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Apache Parquet：column pruning 與 row-group statistics
related.titleEn: Apache Parquet: column pruning and row-group statistics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以唯一 member 與 score 建排行，確認更新分數不會新增第二筆同 member。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build a leaderboard of unique members and scores and verify updating one member does not duplicate it. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 同時用投影欄位與 min/max 篩掉不需要的 row group，計算可讀取的資料量。
related.differenceEn: Use projection and min/max predicates to prune columns and row groups and compute candidate bytes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

Parquet 以 row group 中各 column chunk 組織；統計可排除確定不匹配群，但候選仍須檢查。 教學基準：4*5*10 = 200 unpruned MiB；第二檢核：1*2*10 = 20 candidate MiB after two prunings。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Parquet organizes column chunks within row groups; statistics can exclude impossible groups while candidates still require filtering. Teaching baseline: 4*5*10 = 200 unpruned MiB; second check: 1*2*10 = 20 candidate MiB after two prunings. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries.
